Chapter 6949: Who Are You?

Chapter 6949: Who Are You?

When immortals burned their true blood, they gained incredible results. Alas, all seven struggled futilely against Li Qiye’s supreme will.

He extinguished their temporary boosts instantly, like a flood wiping out a bonfire.

“Focus on kneeling.” He smiled.

“Crack.” Their bones were shattered, and blood covered them from top to bottom.

Once enough broke, their will alone was no longer enough. They prostrated on the ground like piles of blood, drawing their last breaths.

The gruesome takedown frightened spectators. This somehow scared overlords and immortals more than the destruction of worlds or the refinement of countless living beings.

What in particular horrified them? The display of how fragile immortals could be, and a power not seen in the primordial stage. They could accept this more if Li Qiye were a celestial immortal.

“What is the source of his power?” A primordial immortal said.

“A celestial immortal?” Heaven’s Equal wondered.

“The high heaven...?” Apex said before shaking his head.

“That can’t be.” Heaven’s Equal said.

Although none had seen the high heaven before, they had seen its various forms after surviving numerous apocalypses.

Despite knowing that the avatars weren’t the true high heaven, they were still afraid all the same. This feeling would resurface if Li Qiye were another avatar originating from the high heaven.

Breaker Immortal staggered backward upon seeing this monstrous mortal.

“He’s, he’s Enlightener, Eternal Sacred Teacher!” Once Heaven’s Equal got a closer look, he recognized Li Qiye.

“What?!” The immortals exchanged glances and took a deep breath.

“The dao proliferation.” Everyone understood this being’s wondrous feat.

When the dao crumbled, Enlightener alone spread the trees and created a new system for all worlds.

“Wait...” Heaven’s Equal found something was wrong.

When he had met Enlightener, this being was engulfed in primordial chaos true energy. There was also a primordial tree.

This mortal didn’t have a tree or a similar energy. Although they looked similar in appearance, he was not Enlightener.
